name: Surge AI
desc: Expert human data and RLHF services for frontier labs
desc_zh: 面向前沿实验室的专家数据与 RLHF 服务
solves: Smart is not useful. Training on agreeable crowd answers teaches a model to be agreeable. Domain experts are sourced instead, and benchmarks are built in-house.
solves_zh: 聪明不等于有用。用讨好的众包答案训练，只会让模型也变得讨好。改为找领域专家，基准也自己出。
best_for: When a frontier lab needs preference and RLHF data a general crowd cannot produce.
best_for_zh: 当前沿实验室需要通用众包做不出来的偏好数据和 RLHF 数据时。
notes: Shows quality of training data, not headcount, decides model behaviour. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://www.cbinsights.com/compare/labelbox-vs-surge-ai
